rationale: The replication successfully builds the full coupled Schrödinger+Landau-Lifshitz time integrator from scratch and reproduces the paper's central dynamic claim: current-driven finite-time topological collapse Q:-1→0. Static results (BP exchange energy 4πJ to <0.5%, topological charge Q=±1, self-similar exponents α=1, β=1/2) match exactly. Dynamic trends are correct: t* decreases with dissipation β (Fig.3 trend), t* increases linearly with λ₀, and the collapse only proceeds when |S|=1 conservation is broken by exchange dissipation. The absolute t* is order-of-magnitude correct (~10³ t₀) rather than exact due to mean-field electron reduction on smaller lattice, and detailed b-field maps are not produced—these are quantitative fine-details, not mechanism failures.
